# Reified documentation

Start at `/getting-started/`: one complete transaction — a model declaration, untrusted input parsed into it,
accumulated path-aware failures, and a JSON codec derived from the same declaration.

Reified documentation is split by capability. Load only the context needed for the task:

- Result composition, `result { }`, and accumulating builders: `/result-handling/llms.txt`
- Reusable value rules and structured violations: `/constraints/llms.txt`
- Primitive text decoding: `/parsing/`
- Invariant-carrying types: `/refined/`
- Structured fixtures, immutable edits, comparisons, and produced-data matching: `/data/llms.txt`
- Schema parsing, JSON codecs, versioned contracts, and path-aware diagnostics: `/schema/llms.txt`

The main documentation order is Result handling, Constraints, Parsing, Refined, Data, and Schema.

`Reified` is an umbrella package that installs every runtime package at once. It adds no API of its own: every
type still comes from the package documented above.

Effects, services, concurrency, and hosting are not part of Reified. They live in Axial
(https://github.com/adz/Axial).
